format: cells[]: one training cell each: train_cases (nested prefix of the seed stream), train_examples (= train_cases x 2 tasks), epochs, batch_size, optimizer_steps, dev_evals (= epochs; one dev generation pass per epoch end), dev_eval_items, eval_items (two tasks x 1,000 test cases), timeout_minutes, optional (true: run only when STAGE_B_CURVES=1). zero_shot[]: generation-only baselines of eval_items each. totals: sums over the required cells; totals_with_optional: over every cell.
